scope: Independent TaylorF2_HM numerical oracle for the combined aligned-spin, reference-frequency, and Schwarzschild per-mode-cutoff waveform

required_coverage.amplitude_scope: leading nonspinning amplitude of each mode
required_coverage.phase_scope: declared aligned-spin TaylorF2 phase, including an identified native spin_order recipe
required_coverage.phase_origin: arbitrary finite f_ref with the 2*f/m map
required_coverage.cutoff: per-mode Schwarzschild ISCO hard mask, including the retained equality bin
required_coverage.comparison: unaligned complex per-mode and summed h_plus/h_cross values

candidates.name: Mishra et al. author supplement
candidates.license_record: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; no software reuse license established
covers: symbolic H[l,m] definitions for all required modes
harmonic Theta[-f + k*Fcut] factors in the separate full-PN Ckn polarization expansion
missing_or_incompatible: no arbitrary f_ref input or reference-frequency subtraction
default spin_order=7 omits the supplement's cubic-spin v^7 term
spin_order=8 additionally requires the Pratten et al. quadratic-spin v^7 term absent from the supplement
Ckn is a full-PN polarization expansion, not the declared leading-amplitude raw-mode carrier
the native per-mode hard cutoff is a project truncation rather than a source amplitude

candidates.name: LALSuite public TaylorF2 binary API
missing_or_incompatible: no public frequency-domain TaylorF2 mode generator

paper_benchmark_decision.reason: Adding finite-f_ref subtraction, selecting a native spin recipe, importing the separate SS7 term when requested, projecting the leading modes, and applying the native cutoff would make the expected series a new project-authored composition of the same equations already exercised by the independent scalar reference. Freezing those outputs would improve reproducibility but not source independence, so it cannot close the external numerical-oracle gate.

closure_contract.acceptable_release: A checksum-pinned, suitably licensed author or independently maintained executable, or a published numerical table with sufficient precision
required_manifest: all binary parameters, distance, inclination, phi0, phic, tc, and nonzero aligned spins
explicit Fourier, tetrad, raw-mode-label, and phase-origin conventions
the exact aligned-spin term set and arbitrary finite f_ref
all eight complex modes or both complex polarizations for every mode contribution and their sum
frequencies below, exactly at, and above every mode cutoff
closure_contract.test_rule: Compare bins directly with no time, phase, amplitude, or frequency alignment; require the stated FP64 normalized complex threshold and exact masked zeros in both Torch and JAX.
